name: ai-omni-commander
description: AI-OmniCommander: MCP server providing task management and execution context (specs, gates, verification) to external Claude Code sessions

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run start -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:watch: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.verify: npx vitest run --config server/vitest.config.ts && tsc --build && cd web && npx vitest run && npx vite build
